item.title: The tools keep the record. The workspace shows the work.
item.description: Four kinds of information stay apart: the record, the evidence, the draft, and the person. Twin prepares within authorized context. Consequential actions need the right authority.

item.title: Stop being the translator between your tools

item.title: Why AI needs your approval — every single time
item.description: Most AI tools act first and ask questions later. We built Spine InnovTech the opposite way, and here's why that matters.
